plan.major: Humanities and Cultures - History Education Concentration
plan.notes: Source: Ocean County College Academic Catalog 2026-2027, 'History Education Concentration' (catalog.ocean.edu/areas-study/humanities-cultures/history-ed/), Associate in Arts (A.A.) in Humanities and Cultures - History Education Concentration, 'Total Credit Hours 60' (verified 2026-10-09). All 4 semesters transcribed; sums verified against published totals (14/16/15/15 = 60). STRUCTURAL NOTE (verified against raw catalog HTML): the grid lists 'History Gen. Ed. Requirement' (3 cr) slots each year; HIST 175 'History of New Jersey (Recommended)' appears with an EMPTY credit cell directly under the Fall Two requirement slot - it is the catalog's recommended course to satisfy that 3-credit slot, NOT an additional course (counting it separately would break the published 15-credit Fall Two total). It is documented in the Fall Two placeholder's choice_note. 'Choose one of the following' (3 cr) in Spring Two is satisfied by ARTS 181, ARTS 182, or MUSC 190 (options array). Or-choices transcribed with options arrays (MATH 151/156; CSIT 110/123; HIST 171/181; HIST 191/SOCI 238; HIST 172/182). BIOL 161 & 161L transcribed as a single lecture+lab row per convention.
